_comment: T0 Rooftop night fauna as designed on the Bestiary Grid (user, 2026-09-06). Design source for tools/build_roof_fauna.py, which writes the enemy types, roof-band stats, drops, per-district night spawn lists and sprite strips. hp/damage/speed are taken literally (speed in blocks/s). Edit here or on the grid, then re-run the tool.

industrial-t0.lives: Rooftops around vents, machinery, and maintenance areas
industrial-t0.look: large brown rat with patchy oily fur, oversized teeth, and a long scarred tail
industrial-t0.name: rooftop rat

industrial-t0-ironback-roach.lives: Rooftops beneath machinery and inside maintenance structures
industrial-t0-ironback-roach.look: oversized black cockroach with a thick dark shell and unusually heavy abdomen
industrial-t0-ironback-roach.name: ironback roach
industrial-t0-ironback-roach.special: Hard shell reduces incoming damage slightly

industrial-t0-scrap-mantis.attack: slashes the player with its forelegs
industrial-t0-scrap-mantis.lives: Rooftops around piles of scrap and industrial equipment
industrial-t0-scrap-mantis.look: large green-brown praying mantis with oversized forelegs and bits of metal debris caught in its body
industrial-t0-scrap-mantis.name: scrap mantis
industrial-t0-scrap-mantis.special: Briefly freezes before making a fast attack

industrial-t0-cable-leech.attack: latches onto the player and drains them
industrial-t0-cable-leech.lives: Rooftop electrical cabinets, conduits, and cable runs
industrial-t0-cable-leech.look: pale elongated leech with a circular mouth and tiny electrical burns along its body
industrial-t0-cable-leech.name: cable leech
industrial-t0-cable-leech.special: Can remain motionless until the player gets close

construction-t0-rebar-spider.lives: Scaffolding, exposed rebar, and unfinished floors
construction-t0-rebar-spider.look: large gray spider with long thin legs and a pale abdomen covered in dark markings
construction-t0-rebar-spider.name: rebar spider

construction-t0-dust-beetle.lives: Concrete piles, rubble, and unfinished rooftop floors
construction-t0-dust-beetle.look: large beetle with a dusty gray shell and thick armored legs
construction-t0-dust-beetle.name: dust beetle
construction-t0-dust-beetle.special: Charges in a straight line when attacking

construction-t0-crane-rat.lives: Cranes, scaffolding, cables, and elevated construction platforms
construction-t0-crane-rat.look: lean gray rat with oversized paws, a long balancing tail, and patches of missing fur
construction-t0-crane-rat.name: crane rat
construction-t0-crane-rat.special: Can cross narrow ledges without slowing down

construction-t0-brickback.lives: Rubble piles and sheltered areas of unfinished buildings
construction-t0-brickback.look: stocky armadillo-like creature with a rough reddish shell resembling chipped brick
construction-t0-brickback.name: brickback
construction-t0-brickback.special: Tucks into its shell when heavily damaged

business-t0-office-crow.lives: Skyscraper rooftops, signs, and window ledges
business-t0-office-crow.look: large black crow with an unusually long beak and patches of gray feathers
business-t0-office-crow.name: office crow
business-t0-office-crow.special: Can quickly fly over small obstacles

business-t0-glasswing-bat.lives: Skyscraper roofs and dark spaces around office towers
business-t0-glasswing-bat.look: pale bat with thin translucent wings and oversized ears
business-t0-glasswing-bat.name: glasswing bat
business-t0-glasswing-bat.special: Difficult to see against the night sky

business-t0-window-gecko.lives: Glass windows, ledges, and exterior walls
business-t0-window-gecko.look: pale blue-gray gecko with oversized adhesive feet and large reflective eyes
business-t0-window-gecko.name: window gecko

business-t0-pigeon-swarm.attack: swarm attacks the player with pecks and wing strikes
business-t0-pigeon-swarm.lives: Rooftops, signs, balconies, and building ledges
business-t0-pigeon-swarm.look: dense flock of oversized gray pigeons with swollen eyes and ragged feathers
business-t0-pigeon-swarm.name: pigeon swarm
business-t0-pigeon-swarm.notes: Represents an entire flock rather than a single bird

residential-t0-poison-frog.look: green tree frog with dark green legs
residential-t0-poison-frog.name: poison frog

residential-t0-chimney-bat.lives: Chimneys, attic vents, and rooftop structures
residential-t0-chimney-bat.look: large brown bat with oversized claws and torn ears
residential-t0-chimney-bat.name: chimney bat
residential-t0-chimney-bat.special: Can hide inside chimneys until disturbed

residential-t0-gutter-snake.lives: Gutters, drains, roof gardens, and sheltered roof spaces
residential-t0-gutter-snake.look: thin dark snake with an unusually long body and pale eyes
residential-t0-gutter-snake.name: gutter snake
residential-t0-gutter-snake.special: Can remain hidden inside narrow spaces

residential-t0-roof-cat.lives: Residential rooftops, patios, and abandoned homes
residential-t0-roof-cat.look: lean feral cat with oversized claws, patchy fur, and glowing yellow eyes
residential-t0-roof-cat.name: roof cat

commercial-t0-grease-rat.lives: Restaurant rooftops, exhaust systems, and dumpsters
commercial-t0-grease-rat.look: large fat rat with greasy black fur and a swollen belly
commercial-t0-grease-rat.name: grease rat

commercial-t0-sign-bat.lives: Inside large rooftop signs and illuminated storefront signs
commercial-t0-sign-bat.look: dark brown bat with a broad wingspan and bright reflective eyes
commercial-t0-sign-bat.name: sign bat
commercial-t0-sign-bat.special: Begins combat from above when disturbed

commercial-t0-dumpster-raccoon.lives: Dumpsters, restaurant roofs, and commercial waste areas
commercial-t0-dumpster-raccoon.look: oversized raccoon with thick forearms, dirty gray fur, and a damaged black mask marking
commercial-t0-dumpster-raccoon.name: dumpster raccoon

commercial-t0-grease-mantis.lives: Restaurant exhaust vents and rooftop kitchen equipment
commercial-t0-grease-mantis.look: large brown praying mantis with greasy black patches and elongated forelegs
commercial-t0-grease-mantis.name: grease mantis

civil-t0-sewer-rat.lives: Municipal drains, maintenance access points, and civic rooftops
civil-t0-sewer-rat.look: large scarred gray rat with missing patches of fur and a blunt tail
civil-t0-sewer-rat.name: sewer rat

civil-t0-bell-bat.lives: Civic towers, bell towers, and dark rooftop structures
civil-t0-bell-bat.look: dark gray bat with oversized ears and a pale face
civil-t0-bell-bat.name: bell bat
civil-t0-bell-bat.special: Uses sound to locate nearby movement

civil-t0-statue-pigeon.lives: Monuments, statues, courthouses, and public buildings
civil-t0-statue-pigeon.look: large gray pigeon with patches of hard stone-like skin across its wings and breast
civil-t0-statue-pigeon.name: statue pigeon
civil-t0-statue-pigeon.special: Hard patches make it slightly resistant to damage

civil-t0-roof-lizard.lives: Public building roofs, vents, and sun-warmed surfaces
civil-t0-roof-lizard.look: dark green lizard with unusually long legs, a narrow head, and bright yellow eyes
civil-t0-roof-lizard.name: roof lizard
